highlights: Agent ecosystem infrastructure advanced sharply as Google introduced dynamic Tool Retrieval to cut API overhead while OpenAI launched GPT-Live-1.1 with low-cost standby WebRTC streaming.
Local model capabilities saw breakthroughs with Thinking Machines' 26B Inkling 2 Mini running on 32GB RAM Mac devices and RadixArk's RL-only DaisyRose-27B doubling coding benchmark performance.

Hardware engineering and formal verification tools gained traction with Columbia/CertiK's TensorLean uncovering critical bugs in FlashAttention and OpenAI models directly optimizing RISC-V silicon designs.

agents.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge: A 2B Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor
agents.summary: NVIDIA launched a 2B vision-language-action model designed for real-time autonomous driving trajectory planning and explanations with low 160-190ms latency on DRIVE AGX Thor.

agents.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min
agents.summary: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1 featuring improved multilingual transcription and a novel WebRTC standby mode that slashes idle monitoring costs by 60%.

agents.title: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B: RL-Only Agentic Coding Model
agents.summary: An open Apache 2.0 27B coding agent post-trained purely with reinforcement learning that doubles Terminal Bench 4.1 performance and runs on a single GPU.

models.title: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE for Local Hardware
models.summary: Inkling 2 Mini packs 26.4B parameters (3.4B active) into a looped MoE architecture scoring 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified while running locally on 32GB Macs.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma Continuous Diffusion Language Models
models.summary: NVIDIA open-sourced 14 continuous diffusion language model checkpoints (3B and 8B) that denoise in latent space to achieve up to 4.2x faster decoding than standard autoregressive LLMs.

models.title: Baseten Ships Bison-1 and Groundhog-1 Decision Models
models.summary: Built on Gemma 4, these open-weight 128k-context decision models support multimodal inputs and top the AA Decision Index v2.1 benchmark for autonomous action selection.

tools.title: Google AI Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
tools.summary: Allows developer agents to hold hundreds of tools in reserve and dynamically retrieve only necessary parameter schemas on-demand within a single request, drastically reducing prompt token count.

tools.title: Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels
tools.summary: A PTX-level formal verification system using Lean that successfully proved 83 production GPU kernels correct and surfaced 38 bugs in libraries like FlashAttention and DeepGEMM.

tools.title: Inside the Codex Sandbox: Secure Local Execution Environment
tools.summary: OpenAI detailed the sandboxing architecture powering Codex, enabling local CLI commands to execute safely under granular user-controlled filesystem and network boundary rules.

companies.title: Hebbia Tests OpenAI GPT-6 Astra for Financial Research
companies.summary: Hebbia integrated prerelease evaluations of GPT-6 Astra into financial research workflows, recording major performance gains in citation precision, source retrieval, and synthesis quality.

companies.title: OpenAI Models Optimize Jalapeño Silicon and RISC-V Chip Designs
companies.summary: OpenAI demonstrated successful AI-assisted hardware design by using specialized models to optimize physical circuits in Jalapeño silicon and improve RISC-V core structures.

companies.title: Google and Adobe Integrate Creative and AI Tools Across Drive and Gemini
companies.summary: Google announced an expanded partnership with Adobe to embed Adobe AI editing tools directly into Google Workspace applications and the Gemini assistant ecosystem.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: A step-by-step developer guide covering data preparation, LoRA training configurations, and performance optimization for custom 3D mesh generation pipelines.

learning.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
learning.summary: A hands-on technical tutorial using NVIDIA SimReady assets within Hugging Face workflows to simulate robotic manipulation and pick-and-place routines.

learning.title: Deploying Daybreak Red: Security Investigation Reference Architecture
learning.summary: A practical guide and reference implementation showing engineering teams how to deploy supervised AI security investigation pipelines with granular audit controls.
